criteria.text: Identifies that the Lowther Engineering Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.

Identifies the threatened $1,200,000 claim by Delamere Bioscience plc recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Redcliffe Robotics Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Explains how 'material adverse effect' could be read narrowly or broadly and what each reading means for the Buyer's walk-away right.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
